text: Doing leg raises for your lower abs... but you only feel it in your hips?
A crunch curls your ribs toward your hips. That's your six-pack muscle, the rectus abdominis.
Swinging your legs up is mostly your hip flexors. Your abs only kick in when you curl your pelvis up at the top.
And there's no separate lower ab. It's one long muscle.
So on leg raises, curl your hips up, don't just swing. Save this.
